title: Branded not labeled

posts.caption:
No logo on the leather. Here is where the DAUR mark lives.

A brass lace tag on the bottom row, threaded on thick matte black cotton laces that replace the factory pair. The leather shoes stay clean and the hardware carries the name. Men's leather shoes and sneakers for Pakistan, branded, not labeled.

First photo: mood photography of leather craft (Pexels), not our workshop. Kit shown is a design render.

Send this to the friend who still pays for the logo.
